201.description: The published version and how many onboardings it was linked to.

id.description: The version's own id: what a link, and the accept route, name.

key.description: The family this is a version of.

type.description: What an agreement family is: terms, or a privacy notice. A property of the family rather than of one version, so every version published under one `key` classifies the same way.

allOf.description: What an agreement family is: terms, or a privacy notice. A property of the family rather than of one version, so every version published under one `key` classifies the same way.
allOf.title: AgreementType

version.description: Monotonic within the family, from 1. The engine derives it; nobody submits it.

linkedOnboardings.description: Onboardings this publish linked the new version to as pending, each of which was notified. One already holding the version is neither counted nor notified.

400.description:
The body or query violates its declared shape; `message` names each violated rule.

`AGREEMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH`: `key` is already published under another type; `publishedType` and `requestedType` name the two. The type belongs to the family and cannot change between versions.

oneOf.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
oneOf.title: NestHttpError

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

403.description: The token verifies but its `roles` claim holds none of `ADMIN_REQUIRED_ROLES`; signing in again cannot fix this.

409.description: `AGREEMENT_VERSION_CONFLICT`: A concurrent publish of `key` won the same version number. Nothing is wrong; publish again.

503.description: Entra's signing key set could not be reached, so the token was never judged. Retry.
